title: Syntactically linear circuits
statement: Let $F$ be a commutative ring and let $\iota$ be an input-index type. Input wires and constants are linear circuits; a sum is linear exactly when both of its inputs are linear; scalar multiplication preserves linearity; and every multiplication gate is classified as nonlinear.
